meta.title: LIVO PPWR · Packaging compliance in one calm place
meta.description: Keep every packaging type, obligation and document in one place. Built for the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation.

hero.titleLine2: The work behind it quickly multiplies.
hero.lead: The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation has applied since 12 August 2026. LIVO PPWR keeps packaging data, obligations, evidence and supplier input together and up to date, so your team knows where it stands.

whyNow.title: One regulation. A lot of new obligations.
whyNow.body: PPWR (Regulation (EU) 2025/40) applies directly across the EU and replaces the old Packaging Directive. It reaches every company that places packaging on the EU market, whatever its size.

cards.title: Prove conformity
cards.body: Each packaging type needs an EU Declaration of Conformity and technical documentation, kept on file for years.

cards.title: Meet design rules
cards.body: Recyclability, recycled content, packaging minimisation and PFAS limits all carry their own thresholds and dates.

cards.title: Avoid the fallout
cards.body: Gaps can mean fines, recalls or losing a retail listing. The work is real. The stress doesn't have to be.

what.title: Your whole packaging compliance, in one place.
what.body: Register, obligations, documents, suppliers and deadlines: connected, so nothing falls through the cracks.

features.title: Packaging register
features.body: Every packaging type you place on the market, in one list: material, weight, format and owner, found in seconds.

features.title: Obligations matrix
features.body: See at a glance which rules apply to each packaging type, and exactly where you still need to act.

features.title: Documents & Declarations of Conformity
features.body: Keep every DoC and technical file with its packaging. Upload once, and it's always where you expect it.

features.title: Suppliers
features.body: Collect the data and proof you need from suppliers, with the right owner set for you automatically.

features.title: Timeline & deadlines
features.body: PPWR phases in through 2030 and beyond. LIVO keeps the dates that matter to your packaging in view.

features.title: Compliance status
features.body: A calm, honest picture of where you stand today, with a clear next step. Never a wall of red.

principles.title: The software shouldn't add to the complexity.
principles.body: PPWR is demanding enough. Every screen in LIVO PPWR follows the same principles: the ones that make work feel lighter.

items.title: Simplicity over features
items.body: One primary action per screen. Everything you need, nothing you don't.

items.title: Errors that help
items.body: No raw system messages. Not {code}, but “That file is a little large. Try one under 15 MB.”

items.title: Calm by design
items.body: Generous whitespace and progressive disclosure keep dense pages quiet. Detail appears when you ask for it.

items.title: Smart defaults
items.body: A document is named after its file. The supplier owner is set for you. Less typing, fewer mistakes.

items.title: Validation as you go
items.body: Fields are checked while you work, so you never complete a whole form only to hit a wall at the end.

items.title: Human in the loop
items.body: You stay in control. The software suggests and prepares; you decide and confirm.

get.title: From a messy supplier file to a declaration you dare to sign.
get.body: That chain is the product. Every step below works today, in every paid plan.

items.title: Import any Excel, no rigid template
items.body: Upload your own data exports or whatever a supplier sends. Livo reads the structure (bottle, box, carton, pallet), shows you what it found and asks when it isn't sure. You confirm instead of retype, and the same file shape is recognised next time. No fixed format to fight with first.

items.title: Ask suppliers via portal and tasks, not email threads
items.body: Request exactly what's missing: your supplier gets a link with plain-language questions and tasks, legally reviewed guidance per field, and a place to drop their PDFs. No mailbox full of half-filled spreadsheets, and nothing a supplier sends ever overwrites what you already had.

items.title: Always know where you stand
items.body: One live overview of your obligations, deadlines and readiness: per product, per role, per market, through 2040. And it stays honest: expired evidence automatically stops counting, so the status you see is the status that's true today.

items.title: The complete compliance file, per product
items.body: Declaration of conformity, technical file, test documents and an append-only attestation trail, generated from your own data and kept together per product. Livo waits until the required evidence is there, and signing is a separate right. When someone asks how you know, you show them.

replaces.title: Compare the whole bill, not the licence line.
replaces.body: Traditional compliance software is rarely just a licence. The number that matters is what leaves your account in a year, and how well you could predict it in advance.
replaces.footnote: Figures for traditional suppliers are the ranges we see quoted in this market; your mileage will vary. The point isn't that we're cheap. It's that you can work out your total cost before you sign, and it stays that way.

everyPlan.freeNote: Free is the one plan with limits: it stops at 25 SKUs and leaves out signed declaration downloads and integrations. Everything else is identical.
everyPlan.onboarding: Getting started: there's no implementation fee and no implementation project. We set up your environment with you (markets, users and roles), usually within a day. From there it's yours to run. Self-service onboarding is being built; until it ships we'd rather do that step with you than pretend it's already a button.

integrations.title: Integrations aren't here yet. When they ship, they're in your plan.
integrations.body: Only Excel import and export exist today, and they carry the whole workflow. The connectors below are still to be built. We list them so you know what's coming and, more importantly, that they'll simply be part of your plan when they arrive.

items.title: Excel import & export
items.body: Upload the supplier template, review what we recognised, confirm. Re-import updates instead of duplicating.

items.title: Native ERP connectors
items.body: Exact Online first. Dynamics 365 BC, SAP Business One and Odoo follow where customers ask for them.

items.title: REST API + integration builder
items.body: Connect your PIM or any other system yourself: map the fields in the app, no code required.

items.title: GS1 / GDSN publishing
items.body: Publish packaging and PPWR attributes straight to the data pool, with code-list mappings as a ready-made template.

integrations.custom: A system of your own? A legacy or niche integration is tailored work: a one-time development fee quoted up front, plus a monthly care fee from €199.

items.q: What exactly counts as a SKU?
items.a: One sellable product you put on the EU market yourself: under your own brand (private label included) or as the importer. Packaging levels, components and materials are never counted, however many you have. Everything you resell as a distributor is free and unlimited, and archived products don't count either.

items.q: What if I go slightly over my plan?
items.a: Nothing happens. We look at a rolling three-month average, so a seasonal peak passes by unnoticed. If your portfolio is structurally larger, we'll get in touch and move you up. You'll never find out through a blocked screen or a surprise invoice.

items.q: My suppliers are slow. Does that block me?
items.a: It's the most common bottleneck, so the product is built around it: send a portal link or export exactly what's missing, and a partly filled return leaves what you already had intact. You keep working on everything else, and you can see per product who you're waiting on.

items.q: Are there setup or implementation fees?
items.a: No. Connectors, the API and GS1 publishing will be included in paid plans when they ship. The one exception is a fully custom integration with a legacy system: tailored work, quoted up front.
Any time, in one click from Billing. Your data stays yours and stays exportable; anything above a lower limit becomes read-only, never lost.

items.q: Why is this simpler than everyone else?
items.a: Because the price follows the regulation. PPWR puts the obligations on whoever places a product on the market. We count exactly those products and charge for them, nothing else. That takes out the scoping call, the implementation project and the quote you can't compare.
